title: Move DefaultHarnessBytes out of the factory dashboard
description:
cmd/tk/cmd/root.go:13 imports internal/factory/dashboard for ONE constant, dashboard.DefaultHarnessBytes, used at root.go:638. root.go is the always-compiled root command file, so this single import is what makes every tk build depend on factory code.

Move the constant to wherever it belongs for a tk that has no factory — it describes a harness default, not a dashboard one. Find its real home; do not just relocate it into another factory-adjacent package.

OWNS cmd/tk/cmd/root.go. root.go is a hot seam — many ticks touch it — so this is deliberately its own tick and nothing else in this epic may edit that file.
acceptance_criteria: cmd/tk/cmd/root.go does not import internal/factory/dashboard. The constant's new home makes sense for a tk with no factory installed, and the choice is explained in a comment. go build ./... and go test ./cmd/... green.
